blocks.text: Calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) aur calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) acidic (tezaabi) mitti mein dale jate hain taake pH barhe (acidity neutralize ho) aur mitti faslon ke liye behtar ho jaye. Calcium aur magnesium paudon ke zaroori nutrients (ghizai ajza) hain. Calcium cell wall banne ke liye bohat zaroori hai, jab ke magnesium chlorophyll ka central atom hai, jo photosynthesis ke liye zaroori hai. Calcium nitrate ya magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) jaise compounds fertilizers (khaad) ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Dow Process ke electrolysis wale step ki balanced equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Mg²⁺(l) + 2Cl⁻(l) → Mg(l) + Cl₂(g), yani pighla hua MgCl₂(l) → Mg(l) + Cl₂(g).

blocks.prompt: b) Limestone se quicklime (CaO) banane ki balanced equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g), 900-1000 °C par garam kar ke.

blocks.prompt: c) CaCO₃ ka ek agricultural (kheti ka) istemal aur us ke peechhe ka chemical principle (usool) batayein.
blocks.explanation: CaCO₃ tezaabi mitti mein dala jata hai taake pH barhe. Principle neutralization hai: CaCO₃ ek base ki tarah mitti ke acid (H⁺) se react karta hai: CaCO₃ + 2H⁺ → Ca²⁺ + H₂O + CO₂.

items: CaCO₃ aur Ca(OH)₂ tezaabi mitti ko neutralize karte hain (pH barhta hai).
Ca cell walls ke liye, Mg chlorophyll ka central atom.
Calcium nitrate aur Epsom salts khaad ke taur par.
